maria_marketing: Quick pitch 1: run a "Launchpad Mini-Labs" week: four 7-minute hands-on tutorials (OSS starter kits) + an optional 20-minute live teardown webinar. Aim: drive GitHub stars, refapp forks, and gated demo signups. Thoughts? kevin_devrel: love the compact format. suggest each lab includes a tiny starter repo, a CI workflow that deploys a live demo, and a one-page benchmark snapshot (latency/cost for a 512-token prompt). keeps friction low. :rocket: rachel_growth: Do we want the webinar gated or open? Gated helps lead quality. propose gated with a short pre-fill (company size + primary use-case) and an opt-in for trial credits. Also push a follow-up drip: 1) thank you + repo links, 2) benchmark highlights, 3) invite to community office hours. ankur_eng: I can own the bench scripts. Plan: run each refapp against hosted API and small Dedicated instance. Metrics: p50/p95 latency, tokens/sec, cost/token. Example run command: ```bash python bench_refapp.py --model redwood-lite --seq 512 --concurrency 4 --requests 250 --output csv ``` I'll include a reproducibility header in CSV: model/version, instance type, timestamp. keiko_design: I'll design an assets bundle: 4 hero cards, 2 email banners (gated + open), and social tiles. Need final tutorial titles + repo links by Tue EOD to start designs. maria_marketing: For messaging let's A/B test two headlines: Variant A: "Get started in minutes: Starter kits for real apps" Variant B: "Ship LLM features with lower inference cost" Keiko + I will make both. We'll run for 72h and pick winner by day 4. kevin_devrel: + add quick-start copy in each README: 3 steps to get running and a clear CTA to claim trial credits. Also add a tiny demo badge that links to the live demo. rachel_growth: Inbound routing: form -> Segment -> Marketo with lead scoring. Score rules: company_size > 50 OR use_case == "customer_support" => sales-qualify. Others => community nurture. We'll capture UTM and github_handle fields. maria_marketing: Good. Can we also add a lightweight email capture on the live demo (modal) to convert anonymous viewers? Kevin, can you add a modal snippet to the demo templates? kevin_devrel: Yep. HTML snippet ready: ```html
``` ankur_eng: One more bench note: please onboard a standard input dataset per refapp (<=100 sample prompts) so benchmarks are comparable. I'll commit sample prompts in /test_prompts/ and reference them in the CSV. keiko_design: For the webinar creative, want a short visual treatment showing "before/after" (no infra vs Redwood runtime). Works with the cost-savings angle. maria_marketing: Timeline proposal: - Tue: tutorial outlines + repo skeletons created - Thu: design assets + landing up on staging - Mon: benchmarks finalized + social scheduling - Wed (launch): tutorials + repos live, gated webinar registration opens - Fri: webinar (or two options next week depending on timezone) rachel_growth: Can we run a small paid test (LinkedIn dev audience) for 48h to validate headline performance? If yes, I'll coordinate budget. kevin_devrel: I'll add a short CONTRIBUTING.md for community to submit their own labs and a license header for OSS clarity. deploy_bot: calendar check: "Launchpad Mini-Labs" window Aug 22-26. No conflicts detected. maria_marketing: Owners recap: - Tutorials + README + demo templates: Kevin - Benchmarks + sample prompts: Ankur - Design + assets: Keiko - Landing + gating + routing: Rachel + Maria - Webinar + registration page: Rachel keiko_design: ping me on any copy updates after Tue EOD. ankur_eng: I'll push initial bench CSV by Wed morning. maria_marketing: Great. I'll draft a short launch playbook (social copy, email templates, tracking checklist) and drop it here before EOD. Any blockers? kevin_devrel: none from devrel. rachel_growth: none. maria_marketing: Closing thread see you Tue for repo stubs.
